name: Letters and Sounds
source: DfES/DfE 'Letters and Sounds: Principles and Practice of High Quality Phonics' (2007), Phases 2–5
licence_note: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0
notes: Phase 4 introduces no new graphemes at all (it is purely CVCC/CCVC/CCVCC blending practice) so its unit has an empty teaches array, matching the same convention used for blend lessons in ufli-foundations.json. Tricky/heart words are attached to the phase in which they are officially introduced.

units.label: Phase 2, Set 1 – s, a, t, p
Phase 2, Set 2 – i, n, m, d
Phase 2, Set 3 – g, o, c, k
Phase 2, Set 4 – ck, e, u, r
Phase 2, Set 5 – h, b, f, ff, l, ll, ss
units.notes: ff, ll, ss (doubled-letter graphemes) are not in app.js's GRAPHEMES table — see NEEDED_GPCS.md. End of Phase 2.

units.label: Phase 3, Set 6 – j, v, w, x
Phase 3, Set 7 – y, z, zz, qu
units.notes: zz is not in app.js's GRAPHEMES table — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Phase 3 – ch, sh, th, ng
units.notes: Unlike elc-bookmarks, both th sounds (thin/this) are taught together here, per official Letters & Sounds practice.

units.label: Phase 3 – ai, ee, igh, oa, oo
units.notes: oo's two sounds (moon/book) are taught together, per official practice.

units.label: Phase 3 – ar, or, ur, ow, oi
units.notes: ow's two sounds (cow/blow) are taught together.

units.label: Phase 3 – ear, air, ure, er
units.notes: ear.ear (hear/near, the NEAR vowel) is the standard Letters & Sounds reading of this grapheme. This differs from elc-bookmarks.json's ear.er, which follows app.js's atypical single example 'early' — see accuracy caveats in the coordinator report. End of Phase 3.

units.label: Phase 4 – adjacent consonants (CVCC / CCVC / CCVCC)
units.notes: No new graphemes — Phase 4 is entirely about blending already-taught single-letter GPCs into consonant clusters (trap = t+r+a+p, jump = j+u+m+p).

units.label: Phase 5 – new graphemes: ay, ou, ie, ea, oy
Phase 5 – new graphemes: ir, ue, aw, wh, ph, ew
units.notes: ue is not in app.js's GRAPHEMES table — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Phase 5 – new graphemes: oe, au, split digraphs (a-e, e-e, i-e, o-e, u-e)
Phase 5 – alternative pronunciations
units.notes: Existing graphemes read with a different, less-common sound (i in 'find', o in 'cold'/'mother', ow in 'blow', ea in 'head'/'break', a in 'wasp', y in 'fly'/'happy'/'gym', soft c/g, ch as /k/ or /sh/). Not exhaustive — Phase 5 runs all of Year 1, so more heart words are introduced across the year than listed here; verify the full list against the official document.
